validity.recommendation: check whether the owner is Inter RAO Elektrogeneratsiya, the project customer, and not Alrosa-Gas
validity.researcher_notes: The project exists and is at the design and permitting stage. The design documents give 207 km, 530 mm pipe and 4.7 MPa, and a 2024 government order gave 1.454 billion cubic meters a year, all as on the sheet. Both the design volume and the March 2025 notice name Inter RAO Elektrogeneratsiya as the customer for the gas supply pipeline, while the sheet has Alrosa-Gas as owner. Alrosa-Gas is named only as builder of the gas treatment plant. The operator cell is blank on the sheet, and the wiki page says Alrosa-Gas, which no cited page states for the pipeline. The current federal list no longer carries the pipeline.

cross_row_leads.facts: Open-web check: who will own and operate the Srednebotuobinskoye to Novolenskaya pipeline, Inter RAO Elektrogeneratsiya or Alrosa-Gas, and whether construction started.

wiki_citations_read.note: Item of 6 September 2023, read as the Wayback capture of 18 January 2026 because the live page did not load. Says Alrosa-Gas will start building a gas treatment plant at the Srednebotuobinskoye field in 2024 for Inter RAO's Novolenskaya power plant, to be linked by a 200 km pipeline, and that 0.8 to 1 billion cubic meters a year will go to the plant. It gives no owner or operator for the pipeline itself. The sheet's capacity, length and status are already cited to better pages.

wiki_citations_read.note: Alrosa press release of 6 September 2023. Says Alrosa-Gas will build the gas treatment plant, which will be linked to the power plant by a 200 km pipeline. It does not say who will build or own the pipeline, and it gives no capacity figure for it.

Current ConsultantPlus text of the federal list of planned trunk gas pipelines, amended to 9 October 2026. Read in full. It has no entry for the Novolenskaya power plant pipeline and no 1.454 billion cubic meters line, so the 2024 listing the wiki cites has probably been removed in a later amendment.

Item of 26 February 2024, read as the Wayback capture of 22 January 2026. Says government order 406-r of 21 February 2024 put the gas pipeline to the Novolenskaya power plant into the federal territorial plan with a design volume of 1.454 billion cubic meters a year, and that the plant is due to start on 1 July 2028. Supports the recorded capacity and the proposed status. The 2028 date is for the power plant, not the pipeline.

wiki_citations_read.note: Environmental impact design volume for the Novolenskaya power plant gas supply, first stage, linear part. The 7 MB PDF was read in full. It states a main gas pipeline of 207 km, 530 mm pipe, DN500 with a working pressure of 4.7 MPa, and a maximum flow of 166,000 normal cubic meters an hour. The customer is Inter RAO Elektrogeneratsiya. It supports the sheet's length, diameter and pressure.

Public discussion notice of 25 March 2025 for the second stage of the same project. Names Inter RAO Elektrogeneratsiya as the customer, ProektEnergoInzhiniring as general designer and IPIGAZ as the environmental study contractor. It shows the project is still at the design and permitting stage in spring 2025.

summary: "proposed confirmed at design stage; length, diameter, capacity match design papers; owner may be Inter RAO Elektrogeneratsiya, not Alrosa-Gas"
